developerExperience.description: A modern portal, visual database tooling, instant provisioning flows, and integrated services reduce the friction of building modern apps.

callout.label: What is different
callout.title: A sovereign backend platform instead of scattered infrastructure
callout.description: Instead of stitching together overseas managed services, MassiCloud centralizes provisioning, operations, compliance, and tenant isolation in a single developer workflow.

postgres.title: Managed Postgres
postgres.description: Provision database instances with a visual explorer, SQL editor, schema management, and backup/restore workflows.
postgres.point1: Visual ERD, table explorer, filters, sorting, pagination, and row editing.
postgres.point2: Auto-generated REST API via PostgREST plus multi-schema endpoints with identifier sanitization and safe orchestration.
postgres.point3: Daily automated backups, retention policies, exports, imports, and non-destructive restore.

storage.title: S3-compatible storage
storage.description: Create project buckets, browse files, upload with progress, and generate secure presigned URLs from the portal.
storage.point1: Buckets are scoped to projects with public/private policies.
storage.point2: File browser includes folders, breadcrumbs, multi-select, and type-aware actions.
storage.point3: Presigned GET and PUT links support expirations from minutes to days.

controlPlane.title: Integrated control plane
controlPlane.description: Go-based control plane coordinates auth, service roles, projects, instances, cleanup, backups, and managed service orchestration.
controlPlane.point1: Typed config, structured logs, contextual timeouts, and zero global state.
controlPlane.point2: Kubernetes-backed tenant orchestration with rollback on partial failures.
controlPlane.point3: Built to expand into env vars/secrets, cron jobs, monitoring/tracing/logging, cost dashboard, MongoDB, LLM integration, a self-service Kubernetes engine for customer workloads, container registry, public IP controls, and load balancers.

sovereignty.title: Built so foreign cloud lock-in is no longer the default
sovereignty.subtitle: MassiCloud exists because Algerian companies now need both strong developer ergonomics and infrastructure that matches local legal obligations.

residency.title: Data residency
residency.description: The platform is designed around keeping tenant data in Algerian datacenters, rather than making residency an optional add-on.

jurisdiction.title: Algerian jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: The product vision is explicit: customer data should remain accessible under Algerian law, not under foreign cloud vendor regimes.

lawReady.title: Law 18-07 and 25-11 ready
lawReady.description: Audit schemas, consent records, breach logs, and personal-data registry workflows directly support local compliance obligations.

founder.title: Founder-led execution

cta.title: Launch on infrastructure that matches how Algerian products are built
cta.subtitle: Use MassiCloud for sovereign databases, storage, authentication, and compliance-friendly delivery — then grow into observability, automation, Kubernetes abstractions, broader databases, AI integration, networking controls, and realtime as the roadmap ships.

seo.title: MassiCloud — Sovereign cloud platform for Algeria
seo.description: MassiCloud is the sovereign developer platform for Algeria, combining managed Postgres, Redis, S3-compatible storage, and compliance-first infrastructure, running on Kubernetes.

hero.title: Everything you need to ship on sovereign infrastructure
hero.subtitle: MassiCloud combines managed data services, developer tooling, and a control plane designed for Algerian tenancy, operations, and compliance.
hero.description: The product is deliberately focused: ship the services teams need most today, then expand into the missing primitives of a full sovereign developer cloud.

live.title: Live services powering the first customer workloads
live.subtitle: These services are already part of the working product and form the core of the current MassiCloud pilot offering.

postgres.title: Managed Postgres
postgres.description: Production-ready database provisioning with admin tools that feel familiar to modern BaaS users.
postgres.point1: Visual explorer with schemas, tables, columns, indexes, foreign keys, and ERD views.
postgres.point2: SQL editor, row editing, imports/exports, and multi-tab workflows inside the portal.
postgres.point3: Backups, restore-to-new-instance, retention controls, and schema bootstrap options.

redis.title: Managed Redis
redis.description: Dedicated project cache instances controlled from the same platform and identity model as the rest of the stack.
redis.point1: Tenant isolation per project with control-plane lifecycle management.
redis.point2: Aligned operational model with the rest of the MassiCloud platform.
redis.point3: Foundation for future queues, realtime, and event-driven products.

storage.title: S3-compatible object storage
storage.description: Bucket-level access policies, browser-based file management, and presigned URL workflows for uploads and downloads.
storage.point1: Project-scoped namespaces keep storage isolated by tenant.
storage.point2: Uploads, downloads, deletions, folder navigation, and multi-file handling from the portal.
storage.point3: Public/private bucket policies with expirations for secure sharing.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Secure JWT-based authentication and service-role model are live and power the MassiCloud portal and control-plane API today.
auth.point1: JWT token issuance with secure sign-up, sign-in, and session management.
auth.point2: Role-based and service-role access integrated with project and instance-level controls.
auth.point3: Per-project API keys (anon + service_role) are live. SSO and OAuth providers are planned for a future release.

compliance.title: Compliance & Audit Setup
compliance.description: Full compliance schema and AUDIT trail are implemented and live, helping businesses meet Law 18-07 and 25-11 obligations.
compliance.point1: AUDIT schema with triggers tracking inserts, updates, deletes, IPs, and timestamps across all critical tables.
compliance.point2: Compliance schemas for consent records, data subject requests, breach logs, and personal-data registries.
compliance.point3: Ready-to-use structures so businesses can demonstrate governance, auditability, and ANPDP readiness.

soon.title: The full sovereign cloud stack — quarter by quarter
soon.subtitle: MassiCloud grows from a strong data platform into a complete sovereign developer cloud, layering observability, automation, broader databases, AI, infrastructure primitives, and realtime capabilities.

monitoring.title: Monitoring, Tracing & Logging
monitoring.description: Full observability per instance: CPU, RAM, storage, distributed tracing, structured logs, dashboards, and health alerts.

audit.title: Rate Limits & Audit Logs
audit.description: Per-user and per-IP throttling with structured action logs and full audit trail visibility inside the portal.

secrets.title: Environment Variables & Secrets
secrets.description: Encrypted environment variables, versioned project secrets, and secure configuration management for all workloads.

cronjobs.title: CronJobs
cronjobs.description: Managed scheduled tasks with cron expressions, execution logs, retries, and per-project job isolation.

costdashboard.title: Cost Dashboard
costdashboard.description: Pay-as-you-go usage metering with per-project cost breakdowns, spending trends, and budget visibility in the portal.

rabbitmq.title: RabbitMQ as a Service
rabbitmq.description: Managed queues, exchanges, bindings, DLQs, and connection strings per project.

kafka.title: Kafka as a Service
kafka.description: High-throughput streaming for analytics pipelines, event ingestion, and consumer groups.

mongodb.title: Managed MongoDB
mongodb.description: MongoDB as a managed service with a visual document explorer, collections browser, backups, and restore workflows.

llm.title: LLM Models Integration
llm.description: Sovereign Algerian-hosted LLM inference endpoints so AI-powered apps never route sensitive data through foreign clouds.

filesystem.title: File System Storage
filesystem.description: Persistent file system volumes for workloads that need mounted storage beyond object bucket access patterns.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes Engine
kubernetes.description: Managed Kubernetes clusters for containerized workloads with control-plane provisioning and tenant-scoped namespaces.

containerregistry.title: Container Registry
containerregistry.description: Private image registry for building and storing container images with access controls per project.

publicips.title: Public IPs & IP Whitelisting
publicips.description: Assign dedicated public IP addresses to instances and enforce IP-based access rules and allowlists per project.

loadbalancers.title: Load Balancers
loadbalancers.description: Managed load balancer configuration for distributing traffic across instances with health checks and failover.

edge.title: Edge Functions
edge.description: Deploy JavaScript and TypeScript functions with first-class access to MassiCloud services.

realtime.title: Realtime channels
realtime.description: WebSocket subscriptions to Postgres changes, presence, and custom pub/sub events.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Signed outbound events with retries, exponential backoff, and dead-letter queues.

architecture.title: A practical stack designed for reliability first
architecture.subtitle: MassiCloud deliberately uses a grounded operational architecture: Go, Kubernetes, Postgres, Redis, MinIO, and a modern Next.js portal.

controlPlane.title: Single Go control plane
controlPlane.description: Chi router, typed configuration, MinIO SDK, Kubernetes client-go, pgx, and SQL tooling drive provisioning and management workflows.

tenantRuntime.title: Kubernetes-native tenant runtime
tenantRuntime.description: Postgres tenants run as StatefulSets in isolated per-project Kubernetes namespaces, each with a matching PostgREST sidecar.

storageFabric.title: Shared storage fabric
storageFabric.description: A shared MinIO cluster serves project buckets with namespace isolation and S3-compatible behavior.

operations.title: Operational automation
operations.description: Background schedulers handle backups, retention cleanup, and future platform automation without hidden external dependencies.

cta.title: The current release is intentionally narrow — the roadmap is intentionally ambitious
cta.subtitle: Start with the services already live, then track how MassiCloud expands into messaging, secrets, realtime, edge compute, and SDKs.

faq.title: Questions customers will ask first
faq.subtitle: The commercial model is designed around Algerian procurement, compliance, and migration concerns — not generic hyperscaler assumptions.

currency.question: Why price in DZD instead of USD or EUR?
currency.answer: Because local billing matters. MassiCloud is designed for Algerian companies that want procurement in local currency and fewer operational dependencies on foreign payment infrastructure.

invoicing.question: Are invoices and support local?
invoicing.answer: That is the goal of the platform positioning. Enterprise engagements are intended to include local onboarding, local communication, and documentation aligned with Algerian customers.

contracts.question: Can regulated organizations get a custom package?
contracts.answer: Yes. The Enterprise tier exists for custom retention, architecture reviews, phased migration planning, and broader compliance mapping for regulated or higher-risk workloads.

migration.question: Can we migrate from foreign cloud services?
migration.answer: Yes. Managed Postgres already supports export, import, backups, and restore workflows. Migration assistance becomes stronger in Growth and Enterprise engagements.

hero.title: Built for Law 18-07 and 25-11
hero.subtitle: MassiCloud is designed so data protection obligations are reflected in the platform architecture, not bolted on after infrastructure choices are already made.
hero.description: For Algerian companies handling personal data, sovereignty is no longer a branding preference. It is a procurement, risk, and compliance requirement.

laws.title: Two laws define the landscape
laws.subtitle: MassiCloud is positioned around the practical operational implications of Algeria's data-protection framework.

law1807.label: Law 18-07
law1807.title: Personal data protection framework
law1807.description: Law 18-07 sets the baseline obligations around consent, data subject rights, breach handling, and structured accountability for personal-data processing.
law1807.point1: Requires traceability and governance around personal data handling.
law1807.point2: Creates operational needs for auditability, requests, and legal evidence.
law1807.point3: Shapes why compliance tooling must exist inside the platform itself.

law2511.label: Law 25-11
law2511.title: Stronger practical restrictions on data transfers
law2511.description: Storing Algerian personal data on foreign clouds is now a legal risk under Law 25-11 (July 2025). The update tightens cross-border transfer restrictions and increases the practical cost of continuing to rely on foreign infrastructure for customer data.
law2511.point1: Raises the importance of ANPDP-facing readiness and declarations.
law2511.point2: Makes cross-border transfer choices materially more sensitive.
law2511.point3: Pushes local companies toward sovereign infrastructure procurement.

requirements.title: Eight compliance requirements MassiCloud addresses
requirements.subtitle: The product roadmap and current implementation already reflect the core controls Algerian organizations ask for when evaluating data platforms.

residency.title: Data residency by default
residency.description: The architecture is designed to keep tenant data in Algerian datacenters rather than offering residency as a later optional policy.

anpdp.title: ANPDP readiness
anpdp.description: Compliance schemas and records help organizations prepare structured declarations, inventories, and legal documentation. MassiCloud provides the infrastructure and tooling — you remain responsible for filing your own ANPDP declaration if your processing requires one.

dpo.title: Support for DPO workflows
dpo.description: Data request handling is considered directly in the compliance model to support access, deletion, rectification, and portability workflows.

audit.title: Audit trail by design
audit.description: Audit schemas and triggers provide the basis for tracking inserts, updates, deletes, IPs, and timestamps.

consent.title: Consent evidence
consent.description: Consent grants and revocations can be modeled and exported as evidence rather than living in unstructured application code.

breach.title: Breach documentation
breach.description: Structured breach records support the operational response needed for regulated incidents and reporting timelines.

transfers.title: Reduced transfer exposure
transfers.description: The platform positioning exists precisely to avoid routine dependence on foreign-hosted services for sensitive customer data.

encryption.title: Encryption in transit and at rest
encryption.description: TLS, encrypted storage layers, password hashing, and secure service access are part of the security baseline.

penalty.title: Compliance is now a business-risk issue, not just an IT issue
penalty.subtitle: The 2025 regulatory context increases the cost of ignoring sovereignty and personal-data governance when choosing application infrastructure.
penalty.note: The project brief also highlights possible criminal liability, which makes infrastructure choice a legal risk decision for affected organizations.

assurances.title: Sovereignty is translated into concrete platform controls
assurances.subtitle: Rather than promising compliance with marketing language alone, MassiCloud turns the sovereignty story into technical defaults and workflow support.

architecture.title: Architecture-level guarantees
architecture.description: Control-plane, storage, and service design are oriented around local hosting and local legal alignment from the beginning.

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction-first positioning
jurisdiction.description: The value proposition is explicit: infrastructure that is intended to remain under Algerian jurisdiction for Algerian customer workloads.

controls.title: Operational controls
controls.description: Retention, backups, audit support, secure access, and environment controls align the platform with real governance needs.

evidence.title: Compliance evidence
evidence.description: Schemas for consents, data requests, breach logs, and registries help customers generate actual records, not just policy PDFs.

cta.title: Choose infrastructure that lowers both technical and regulatory friction
cta.subtitle: MassiCloud is for teams that need modern developer tooling without accepting unnecessary sovereignty risk.

timeline.title: A quarter-by-quarter path to a full sovereign cloud
timeline.subtitle: The roadmap expands from stronger operational foundations into messaging, broader data services, secrets, edge compute, SDKs, and national scale.

q32026.title: Platform Hardening & Observability
q32026.summary: Make the existing base production-grade with full observability, controls, and environment management.
q32026.point1: Monitoring, distributed tracing, and structured logging with dashboards and health alerts per instance.
q32026.point2: Rate limiting, structured audit logs, and environment variables & secrets management.
q32026.point3: Usage metering foundations and cost tracking per tenant project.

q42026.title: Automation & Messaging
q42026.summary: Add the scheduling and event-driven primitives modern apps need for async processing and background work.
q42026.point1: CronJobs service with scheduling, execution logs, retries, and per-project job isolation.
q42026.point2: Cost Dashboard with pay-as-you-go metering and per-project usage breakdowns.
q42026.point3: RabbitMQ and Kafka as managed services for async processing, event streaming, and consumer groups.

q12027.title: Data Ecosystem Expansion
q12027.summary: Cover the major database models Algerian teams use across greenfield and legacy applications.
q12027.point1: MongoDB as a managed service with document explorer, backups, and restore workflows.
q12027.point2: Point-in-time recovery and cross-region backup replication, extending the restore tooling already shipped for Postgres.
q12027.point3: Sovereign LLM models integration with Algerian-hosted inference endpoints for AI-powered apps.

q22027.title: Infrastructure Primitives
q22027.summary: Give teams the compute and storage building blocks to run any workload on sovereign infrastructure.
q22027.point1: File system storage for persistent volumes and workloads beyond object storage patterns.
q22027.point2: Managed Kubernetes engine with tenant-scoped namespaces and control-plane provisioning.
q22027.point3: Private container registry for image hosting and CI/CD deployment pipelines.

q32027.title: Networking & Compute
q32027.summary: Complete the infrastructure layer with networking controls and turn the platform into a true application runtime.
q32027.point1: Public IP addresses, IP whitelisting, and load balancer configuration for production workloads.
q32027.point2: Edge Functions with logs and SDK access to core services.
q32027.point3: Realtime subscriptions, pub/sub channels, presence tracking, and signed webhook delivery.

q42027.title: Developer Experience Expansion
q42027.summary: Make MassiCloud dramatically faster to adopt from application code and CI/CD pipelines.
q42027.point1: Python and Go SDKs (JavaScript/TypeScript SDK — @massicloud/client — is already shipped).
q42027.point2: MassiCloud CLI for auth, database workflows, and function deployment.
q42027.point3: Migration tooling with rollback support and branch-based workflows.

y2028.title: Scale and National Expansion
y2028.summary: Move from a strong local cloud platform into national default infrastructure with regional ambition.
y2028.point1: Multi-AZ deployments, read replicas, and database branching for high-availability workloads.
y2028.point2: Advanced AI platform features: vector databases, fine-tuned sovereign models, and privacy-first inference.
y2028.point3: Maghreb expansion, DZD billing depth, marketplace integrations, and mobile SDKs.
